sql: SELECT t.team_name, ROUND(AVG(date_diff('day', c.received_at, c.decided_at)), 1) AS avg_days FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id WHERE c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY t.team_name
explanation: The average days from receipt to decision for each team, October 2026.
assumptions: Turnaround is calendar days from received_at to decided_at
